rules: Tier comes from evidenced body type, never calendar cohort.

Historical code-only identities are retained; do not infer legal abolition, successor or merger edges.
national maps to national_context; office_type remains separate.
notes: Justin accepted 2026-09-20 America/Edmonton with 10 named holds (status=approved, production_accepted=true). Holds remain open; not blockers for this landing.
Only President is a direct executive office. Local mayors and regional governors excluded as council-selected offices.
